label: timing_native_model
Model call
hint: OpenCode model attempt start to response-body end, before tool settlement; includes client and network overhead.

label: timing_native_tool
Tool call
hint: OpenCode tool-called to terminal event, independently for each call.

label: timing_observed_output
Observed output
hint: Client receipt of first to last output chunk; not model inference time.

label: timing_observed_tool
Observed tool running
hint: Client receipt of first in-progress to first terminal notification.

label: timing_observed_lifecycle
Observed tool lifecycle
hint: Client receipt of initial call to terminal notification; may include waiting.

label: timing_tool_estimate
Estimated from tools
hint: Sum of recorded tool durations; may be partial or overlap. Not a measured step span.

label: timing_tool_estimate
Estimated from tools
hint: Sum of recorded tool durations; may be partial or overlap. Not a measured step span.

label: timing_boundary_estimate
Estimated step span
hint: Interval between recorded adjacent step timestamps.
